prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop homepage reference for Josh King, product designer. Render only the actual edge-to-edge website canvas at 1536×1024 landscape, with no browser chrome, mockup frame, device, room, desk, or presentation board. The page is a pure black canvas (#030404), extremely minimal and nearly empty. The single expressive element is an animated-looking luminous aurora hugging the outermost perimeter of the viewport, as if Siri has just been activated: soft atmospheric bands of electric cyan, cool blue, violet, and a restrained touch of mint flowing around all four edges and blooming most strongly at the corners. The glow must remain on the outside edge and fade inward quickly, leaving the large center of the page genuinely black and calm. It should feel like northern lights traveling around the frame, not a rectangular gradient border, not a neon tube, not a rainbow frame, and not a loading spinner. The edge light is organic, asymmetrical, layered, smooth, immersive, and premium. Content is restrained and functional. At top-left: JOSH KING in small uppercase Montserrat, warm white. At top-right: WORK LAB ABOUT CONTACT in small DM Sans, muted warm white. Near the bottom-left: PRODUCT DESIGNER in medium Montserrat, warm white, with DESIGN · CODE · AI beneath it in small DM Sans gray. Near the bottom-right: VIEW LATEST WORK in small DM Sans warm white. No other visible copy. Keep at least 90% of the visual field black. No imagery, screenshots, client names, logos, icons, objects, cards, panels, borders, sidebars, texture, grain, glass, shadows, illustrations, metaphors, oversized name typography, serif type, eyebrow headings, numbered navigation, or invented claims. Do not include 41 Realty, The Viv, Reserve, StormForge, or any other brand. Flat black typography surface plus the atmospheric perimeter light only.
